name: @jimtech/medallion
description: Public TypeScript SDK package for the multi-language Medallion SDK.

scripts.check: node scripts/public-surface-check.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vitest run && npm run build
scripts.proto:descriptor: buf build proto --as-file-descriptor-set --path proto/medallion/connect/v1/connect.proto -o proto/medallion-connect.descriptor.binpb && buf build proto --as-file-descriptor-set --path proto/medallion/ontology/v1/ontology.proto -o proto/medallion-ontology.descriptor.binpb && buf build proto --as-file-descriptor-set --path proto/medallion/storage/v1/service.proto -o proto/medallion-storage.descriptor.binpb && node scripts/embed-connect-descriptor.mjs
